intro: Clarice Foster is a Forsaken woman residing deep beneath the bluffs of Mulgore within the Pools of Vision. Far from the plagued glades of Lordaeron, she spends her days in contemplation among the tauren seers and mystics.

sections.t: A Forsaken in the Pools of Vision
p: While most Forsaken remain in the northern lands of Lordaeron rebuilding their kingdom under the Undercity, Clarice Foster has traveled to the heart of the tauren lands in Kalimdor. Sheltered within the cavernous Pools of Vision beneath the mesa of Thunder Bluff, she dwells alongside Forsaken apothecaries and tauren shamans who study the spiritual and elemental mysteries of the earth.
